title: English File Upper-Intermediate, File 10: quantifiers; articles

fixIt.text: Both of my parents is teachers.
Every students must bring a dictionary.

fixIt.explain: hardly any = almost none (no double negative).

fixIt.text: None of my friend came to the party.
The Mekong is longest river in Southeast Asia.
He is an honest man and a best friend I have.
fixIt.explain: the best … I have: only one.

fixIt.text: We tried that new place near the river. A restaurant was very busy.
fixIt.explain: The second time you mention something: the.

fixIt.text: Life is easier for an rich.
fixIt.explain: the + adjective for a group: the rich.

builder.tip: neither of + them: not one or the other.

builder.text: It was the best day ever.

radio.title: A weekend on the island
radio.text: Last month both of my sisters and I spent a weekend on an island near Kep. There was hardly any electricity, and none of us could use our phones, but nobody minded. We stayed in a small bungalow by the sea. The bungalow had no walls on one side, so we could see the sunset from our beds. Every evening the owner cooked the best crab I have ever eaten.
